Paired detailed-balanced lift: actual nominal global costs and all-mark fault entropy

Source interface. Use the exact paired prefix/pending lift in ROOT_REVERSIBLE_PREFIX_LIFT_AND_ADAPTIVE_COST_BOUNDARY_20261111.txt10975ASCII/f5fa66aa. The input has labelled reverse pairs, rational original equilibrium activities a_i>0 with k_r a^y_r=k_bar_r a^z_r, expanded variable-order complexes, and the supplied upper-drift promise for target escape. Each directed nonempty source has private source prefixes and pending C_r. Central observed reactions are C_r->C_bar_r, C_r->0,0->C_bar_r or actual marked nulls. All decoder columns are nonzero and auxiliaries start at zero. There is NO irreversible collision return in this lift.

Fix its rational raw parameters U>=1,K>=1,0<theta<=1/m when m>0,Q=theta^(-1), and a common H large enough that all emitted fine coefficients are at most1. Nominal detailed balance holds at the exact fine activities b_s specified in that note, with b_i=a_i on original species. Xi=2+(2+sum_i(a_i+a_i^(-1)))^(2D+2) pays all activity prefixes. Write s_f for the fine species count, n=|Z|_1, n0=|x0|_1<=N0, and S_b=sum_s b_s. The original note established a nominal mean bound but did not combine it with the physical count identities. That combination supplies the global nominal service below. It is not the missing arbitrary-fault global service.

1. Nonexplosion is available for the entire admitted predictable rate box.

In this particular paired lift, physical population increases only at a unary prefix release or a non-null zero-source observed birth, each by one. Coefficients after clock division are at most1. For multipliers between1/2 and3/2, the positive-population intensity is at most C m_f(1+n). Every marked intensity at population n is at most C m_f(1+n)^2, including nulls and parallel marks. Stop at the first population level R. A linear birth/immigration comparison gives a finite exponential-in-time bound on the stopped mean, uniformly in R; Markov's inequality excludes reaching arbitrarily large R in bounded time. At bounded population all marks are dominated by a finite-rate Poisson process. Hence there is no explosion of hidden, null or observed marks for ANY admitted predictable rule. The exponential comparison is only a localization proof. It is not the desired polynomial all-time cost bound for faulty runs.
